attributes.board_name: Michigan Board of Occupational Therapists (LARA Bureau of Professional Licensing)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Board-approved CE per R 338.1252 (e.g. approved programs, NBCOT-accepted activities, employer workplace training); some activity types are capped at 10 hours per renewal period.
rules.audit_note: By accepting the renewal attestation the licensee certifies the CE, implicit bias and human-trafficking requirements were met; documentation may be requested.

rules.legal_basis: Mich. Admin. Code R 338.1251–338.1252; R 338.1215 (human trafficking)
rules.notes: Hours must be earned in the 2 years before renewal; 2-year renewal cycle, apply online no sooner than 90 days before expiry; OT renewal fee $165.40. A 2025 draft rule set (2024-025 LR) would amend R 338.1252; not confirmed as adopted.
